question: ip-proxy/openproxylist-xyz: add extras.payload_failure_pct = 80.0, the share of the 60 sampled lines that carried no payload, with the stored 60-line probe as its evidence row.
why: The record cites that probe as probe:sources/p/bd/bd85efdb7e78591ca3a4078c123a8c90eeb0356d7264bef5482f0823d84e2aa3.json.gz, a JSON array of 60 rows stored with no probe sidecar. scripts/rq capture --probe refuses a JSON array (it is not a probe record), a lane's lint cannot resolve the hash, and no allowed tool measures a SOCKS5 payload again, so no lane can cite it. Counting its rows gives 12 with payload true and 48 with payload false, so 48 / 60 = 80.0%, the complement of extras.payload_rate_pct 20.0. A session in an own clone can add the field with scripts/fr amend and the stored row dated 2026-10-24 (a probe: row dated before 2026-10-30 needs no capture), or register the file as a probe record first.
